description: Earth's plate count, plate areas and speeds for the plate measures of terrain roadmap T8 (scripts/uwtools/plate_metrics.py --earth). Areas from PB2002, speeds in the no-net-rotation frame of NNR-MORVEL56.
status: unverified: written by the T8.0 worker from the literature without web access (2026-10-18); the 52 areas sum to 12.496 sr against 4 pi = 12.566 sr (99.4 %), so a few digits are wrong; the summary's count, largest share and count above 5 % do not depend on them. Check every number against the two sources before using one as a gate; the RMS speed is an estimate, not a computation from the Euler vectors over the PB2002 polygons.

sources.citation: Bird, P. (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems 4(3), 1027, doi:10.1029/2001GC000252
sources.used_for: plate count (52) and plate areas (Table 1, steradians)

sources.citation: Argus, D. F., Gordon, R. G., and DeMets, C. (2011), Geologically current motion of 56 plates relative to the no-net-rotation reference frame, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems 12, Q11001, doi:10.1029/2011GC003751
sources.used_for: plate count (56) and speeds in the no-net-rotation frame

angular_speed_deg_myr_nnr_morvel56.note: magnitudes of the NNR Euler vectors of the large plates, unverified; a plate's speed is omega R sin(distance from its pole), up to 111 km/Myr per deg/Myr

typical_speed_cm_yr_nnr.note: order of the speeds over each plate in the NNR frame, unverified
